keyword: when was the last time we went to the moon

verifications.claim: The last time humans went to the moon was during NASA's Apollo 17 mission.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Apollo 17 was the sixth and final Apollo mission to land people on the moon.'; R2: 'The last time astronauts traveled that far was Apollo 17, in December 1972.'; R3: 'Apollo 17 — the final mission in the program, which was the last time humans traveled to the moon.'; R4: 'The last crewed mission to the Moon was Apollo 17'; R7: 'Apollo 17 astronauts... were the last humans to visit the Moon'
verifications.reasoning: Multiple references directly state Apollo 17 as the last human moon mission.
